shots.prompt: Wide shot of the kitchen. Dana opens the big refrigerator and peers inside; Aki sits on the kitchen floor watching her. No dialogue. A short upbeat 1990s sitcom slap-bass riff plays, then fades to silence.
Medium shot. Dana, with her head halfway in the refrigerator, says: "Where is the remote?"
Close-up of Aki sitting on the floor, deadpan. Aki says slowly: "Did you look for it?" Then his mouth closes.
Medium shot. Dana turns around holding the fridge door and says: "Everywhere. Even in here."
Close-up of Aki, one ear tilting. Aki says slowly: "The fridge?" Then his mouth closes.
Medium shot. Dana shrugs defensively and says: "Last time it was in the fridge." Then the studio audience laughs, and the laughter fades out.
shots.en: Last time it was in the fridge.

shots.prompt: Wide shot. Dana lies on the floor shining a small flashlight under the low TV cabinet; Aki sits on the sofa watching. No dialogue. A short slap-bass riff plays at the start, then fades to silence.
Close-up of Aki on the sofa, deadpan. Aki says slowly: "Warmer." Then his mouth closes.
Dana stands up hopefully, walks to the curtains by the window, and asks: "Over here?"
Close-up of Aki, deadpan. Aki says slowly: "Colder. Much colder." Then his mouth closes and stays still while the studio audience laughs, and the laughter fades out.
Medium shot. Dana drops onto the sofa next to Aki with a tired sigh and says: "Fine. No TV tonight. Let's just talk."
shots.en: Fine. No TV tonight. Let's just talk.
shots.ko: 됐어. 오늘은 TV 없어. 그냥 얘기나 하자.

shots.prompt: Close-up of Aki, eyes widening slightly. Aki says quickly: "I'll help you look." Then his mouth closes.
Aki stands up on the sofa. A black TV remote is revealed on the cushion exactly where he was sitting. Dana stares at it and says: "You were sitting on it?"
Close-up of Aki, calm and deadpan. Aki says slowly: "It was warm. I kept it safe." Then his mouth closes.
shots.en: It was warm. I kept it safe.

shots.prompt: Dana picks up the remote and narrows her eyes at Aki: "For how long?"
Close-up of Aki, deadpan. Aki says slowly: "Since Tuesday." Then his mouth closes and stays still while the studio audience bursts into laughter.

Wide shot. Dana and Aki sit side by side watching the boxy CRT TV. Aki slowly places one paw on the remote, mouths closed. Laughter turns into applause, then a short slap-bass outro riff plays and fades out. No dialogue.
